title: Salsa Dip 450g

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in the target week. The baseline already reflects recent seasonal trends (back-to-school season in late Aug), with median sales near 68.1 over the past 13 weeks. The 2026-07-06 promotion (20% off) saw a 3.13x lift, but the subsequent week was 56 units (x0.98 vs baseline), with no significant post-promo dip. Past promotions have noise-adjusted lift of x1.47, but no promotion is planned. No evidence of a Labor Day effect. The classical uplift model is correct: no drivers. The baseline is already calibrated and stable.

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-29% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
